The [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] '''MX-10''' was an anti-vehicle [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] emplacement developed by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The MX-10 consisted of a rack of ten medium [[Missile/Legends|missiles]], sufficient for taking out armored [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] and [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]], which could be concealed by use of a collapsible panel. Measuring 40 [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] wide, the panel prevented visual identification of the emplacement. Also, the emplacement did not draw power when placed in stand-by mode prevented [[Sensor/Legends|scanners]] from picking it up. When necessary, a simple pull of a cord could cause the collapsible panel to be dropped.<ref name="HS" />

Like other Mer-Sonn products the MX-10 used missiles based on their popular [[PLX series]]. For just 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each the launcher could fire simple [[Dumb missile|"dumb" missiles]] with no guidance system or so-called [[Smart missile|"smart"]] [[GAM]] missiles at twice the cost. At a price of 2,000 credits each it could also fire [[Savant missile|"savant" missiles]].<ref name="HS" />

==History==
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] base [[Dalgeer's Rim]] used a concealed MX-10 as part of its defensive setup. The launcher was protected by a pair of [[shield door]]s and was recessed into the rim of a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] caldera.<ref name="HS" />
